name: lawyerone
description: Fabao intelligent connector provides regulation search over 2M+ laws and case search over 160M+ court rulings. It also offers legal consultation, contract review, judgment prediction, contract drafting, single-party document generation, document desensitization and more. Helping users quickly locate legal provisions, retrieve similar cases, and efficiently complete legal consultation, contract risk review and other legal tasks.
